Title: Generally available: Azure Databricks Delta Live Tables

Body.Content:
Delta Live Tables (DLT) is a framework for building reliable, maintainable, and testable data processing pipelines. You define the transformations to perform on your data, and Delta Live Tables manages task orchestration, cluster management, monitoring, data quality, and error handling.

Data engineers can automate low-value work such as infrastructure management and focus on driving innovation for batch and streaming workloads. Read more

We have updated the pricing model of Delta Live Tables based on feature enhancements and feedback. Delta Live Tables usage will be charged based on the DLT service tier (core, pro, or advanced) chosen at pipeline creation. There is no price increase as a result of these changes. View detailed DLT pricing on Azure here and FAQ here
